note: The independent auditors of the claude-seo full audit (scripts/claude-seo-audit.mjs). Owner 2026-11-17: "可以 而且可以并行不是吗": three auditors at once over one set of measurements, the same release build, the same claude-seo checklists and weights and the same Google rules library, none seeing another's reply; models mixed (two Opus and one other) so their blind spots overlap less. The third is another Claude model, not Codex: a Codex judge runs read-only without network and cannot ask the local rules library. Each model is a Claude model id for claude -p --model; it wins over site.json agentModel and CLAUDE_JUDGE_MODEL, which still name the verification's model. On a site whose agent is codex every auditor runs on Codex's judge model. The list is part of the key that decides whether an audit is run again.

auditors.why: the model every judgment of this pipeline runs on (lib/claude-exec.mjs JUDGE_MODEL), as the single audit did
a second independent Opus run: the same model reads a long site differently from run to run (site13's seo-audit-3 and seo-audit-4 shared few findings), so two runs of it catch more than one
another model family member with its own blind spots, and it can call the local Google rules library through the same curl rule (a Codex judge cannot)
